newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian bank needs quick selloff - EBRD.
newsitem.headline: Croatian bank needs quick selloff - EBRD.

text.p: The restructuring of Croatia's largest bank Privredna Banka depends on its speedy privatisation, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) said on Wednesday.

Visiting EBRD president Jacques de Larosier, who toured the bank's headquarters in Zagreb on Wednesday, discussed the current banking situation in Croatia with Privredna's managers, said a statement from the bank.
The bank should be quickly restructured into a private, commercial bank if it wants its rehabilitation to work, de Larosier was quoted as saying..
The troubled Privredna is Croatia's largest bank and prime candidate for rehabilitation, which should get underway by the end of this year.
Earlier this week the bank announced it would increase loans to clients. It also put on sale assets in 20 companies it acquired in debt-for-equity swaps.
